name: policy

test_list.description: Derive all supported role and driver combinations and validate through the pinned OpenShell policy schema.
Fail closed on upstream unknown fields, bare-root write access, and non-absolute or traversing paths.
Canonical serialization round-trips and hot reload accepts only the network_policies section.
Emit an exact-host Token Factory profile with credential references only and no secret value.

inputs.name: role
inputs.description: Polaris frame role used for least-privilege derivation.

output_description: An upstream-schema-valid, bounded policy or a typed error.
